text:
```yaml
name: Checks

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [22.x]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Enable Corepack and install PNPM 9
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare pnpm@9.0.0 --activate

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Trim devDependencies from lockfile
        # This step runs a custom script that removes devDependencies
        # from all packages except the isolated package. The script
        # should be added to the repository at scripts/trim-lockfile.js.
        # If the script is missing, the workflow will continue.
        run: node scripts/trim-lockfile.js
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm run lint

      - name: Test
        run: pnpm run test

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm run build
```
